# AI Intelligence Layer

A natural language interface sitting on top of multiple personal developer projects.

## What it does

Takes a plain English question, uses GPT-4o-mini to classify intent, routes the query to the appropriate connector (StackScope for job market data, ChunkDoc for document analysis), and returns a readable plain text answer.

## How it works

1. User submits a question via the frontend
2. GPT-4o-mini classifies intent and selects the right connector
3. The connector calls the relevant internal API
4. The answer is returned as readable text

## Stack

- Backend: FastAPI, Python, OpenAI GPT-4o-mini
- Deployment: Render (API), Vercel (frontend)

## Live

https://ai-intelligence-layer.vercel.app
